1.Note: #1 leads the field to green from the outside, #17 inside.  #1 clears for the lead by the backstretch and jumps in front of #17

2.Note: #5 gets a run on the outside with help from #19 and battles #1 for the lead off turn 4

3.Note: #1 clears for the field and battles ahead of #17, #97 and #5 who are three-wide for 2nd

4.Note: #17 gets alongside #1 for the lead in turn 2 but #1 pulls ahead on the backstretch.  #1, #97 and #17 battle three-wide for the lead off turn 4

5.Note: #17 clears for the lead on the inside, while #1 moves to the outside lane.

7.Note: Top 4 get single file in the outside lane led by #17 and #60

10.Note: #5 gets alongside #17 to battle for the lead, clearing him in turn 3

11.Note: #33 gets alongside and passes #5 for the lead

13.Note: Top 6 get single file at the front led by #33 and #5

19.Note: #33, #5 and #17 continue to run single file at the front of the field.  #1 leads the inside lane and begins to challenge #17 off turn 4

27.Note: Top 7 run single file now, #33 continues to lead

32.Note: #1 leads the inside lane to challenge #17 for 3rd in turn 3.  #88 gets loose from near 5th and stacks up the inside lane off turn 4

33.Note: Because of #88 getting loose the lap prior, the inside lane erodes

34.Note: Leaders begin to mix it up, with #17 getting a run outside #33 for the lead off turn 4.

35.Note: #17 takes the lead in the trioval.  Off turn 4 coming to the line, #5 and #17 make contact, causing both to spin and collect #60.  #97 wins stage 1 followed by #54, #22, #43 and #19.  #23 clinches the 14th Chase spot after finishing the stage in 7th, #6 is eliminated from Chase contention

40.Note: All lead lap cars except #12, #47, #44 pit.  #22 gets off pit road first followed by #54 and #97.  #24 equipment interference

44.Note: Restart: #22 leads from the outside, #97 inside.  #97 clears for the lead off turn 4

45.Note: #34 surges to the lead and blocks both lanes.  Inside lane fades slightly, allowing #34 and #97 to clear the field

46.Note: #33 gets alongside #34 for the lead off turn 2, then clears for the lead in turn 3.

50.Note: #33 and #34 have cleared the field and lead the outside lane.  #19 and #23 battle for 3rd behind them

51.Note: #19 charges to get by #33 for the lead

52.Note: #1 gets a push from #38 to battle for the lead in turn 3 under #19

55.Note: #1 gets alongside #19 to battle for the lead

57.Note: #1 and #38 dive low to block an inside run led by #51.  #1 clears for the lead on the backstretch.

59.Note: #1 runs ahead of the pack, #51, #9 and #38 battle three-wide for 2nd off turn 2

60.Note: #1 moves to the outside lane, allowing #9 (middle lane) and #51 (inside lane) to battle for the lead

61.Note: Top 4 get single file, led by #1, #9 and #24

63.Note: #9 shoots outside #1 to battle for the lead on the backstretch

68.Note: #38 gets a push from #60 to take the lead on the backstretch

69.Note: #9 passes #38 for the lead.  Top 3 run single file on the backstretch before #38 dives down low in turns 3-4 to battle #38 for the lead.

72.Note: #9 and #60 battle for the lead now

79.Note: #9 and #60 continue to run in front of the field, #6 and #38 battle for 3rd

80.Note: All three Team Penske cars (led by #12) lead the inside lane to battle #24 for 4th

81.Note: #12 continues to move up and battles #60 for 2nd

82.Note: #12 now battles #9 for the lead and clears for the spot in turn 3

84.Note: #12 and #2 lead the pack off turn 4, #22 and #9 battle for 3rd behind them

85.Note: #2 gets to the outside lane and clears #12 for the lead on the backstretch.  #9 moves to 2nd

86.Note: #9 dives under #2 in turn 1 to battle for the lead, both remain side-by-side until #2 clears on the backstretch.

88.Note: #2 and #12 battle side-by-side for the lead off turn 4

90.Note: #12 fades slightly in the inside lane, allowing #2, #60 and #9 to clear the field.

91.Note: #60 and #9 charge by #2 on the backstretch, but then #9 gets under #60 to take the lead in turns 3-4.  #12 moves to 2nd

92.Note: #9 leads off turn 4 but has expressed concerns he may not have enough fuel for the rest of the stage

93.Note: #2 gets shuffled out of line and drops from 4th to near 13th on the backstretch

95.Note: #12 gets a run inside #9 to charge into the lead on the backstretch.  #12 wins stage 2 followed by #60, #38, #24 and #34

96.Note: #9 and #12 both pit to top off on fuel

97.Note: 26 lead lap cars pit.  #34 gets off pit road first followed by #19 and #60

98.Note: The remainder of the lead lap cars that hadn't yet pit come to pit road

100.Note: Everyone except #34, #19, #2, #35, #22, #6, #3, #48, #62, #45, #41, #1, #60, #21, #67, #71 pit to top off on fuel.  #7 and #42 make contact causing #42 to spin

102.Note: Restart: #34 leads from the outside, #19 inside.  #34 clears for the lead by turn 2, then blocks both lanes until #19 surges back in the trioval

103.Note: #34, #2 and #22 lead the outside lane as the field begins to string out single file

107.Note: Field begins to battle side-by-side again, with #19 getting under #34 to battle for the lead, passing him in turn 2

110.Note: #6 leads the inside lane and challenges #19 for the lead, clearing him by turn 2.

116.Note: #9 and #6 battle side-by-side for the lead before #6 clears again by turn 4.  #51 moves to 2nd

117.Note: #51 jumps outside #6 to battle for the lead

119.Note: #51 briefly leads before #6 challenges him on the inside. #9 leads the top lane near 4th

123.Note: #51 leads the outside lane, #6 leads the inside lane as they battle for the lead

124.Note: Six of the cars that pitted at lap 121 now run together in a draft, led by #1 who is nearly two seconds a lap faster than the leader's pack

127.Note: #51 and #24 have cleared the pack at the front.

129.Note: #24 and #9 shuffle #51 back as the field begins to single file out

132.Note: Top 4 run single file led by #24, #9 and #19.  The second pack led by #1 now run 18 seconds behind

140.Note: #24, #9 and #5 lead the field as many of the top 10 now run single file.

143.Note: #24, #9, #5, #51, #19, #10, #16 pit.  #42 now leads.  The seven cars that pit cycle far behind the cars that pit at lap 121

150.Note: #38 gets a big bump from #60 and clears #45 for the lead between turns 1-2.  #60 dives under #38 to take the lead at the end of the backstretch.

152.Note: #60 leads #38 and #77 as some of the leaders now run single file.

153.Note: #77 gets by #60 to take the lead.  #60 charges back by #77 on the backstretch, #38 follows him to 2nd

155.Note: Caution:  #77 gets loose in turn 3 battling #60 for 2nd and hits the wall, collecting #43.  #54 also receives damage.  #38 leads

165.Note: Overtime restart: #38 leads from the inside, #60 outside.  #45 gets a shove and makes it three wide on the backstretch.  #38 clears for the lead

166.Note: In turn 2, #38 blocks #45 and gets sideways, triggering a multi-car crash.  #60 takes the lead on the backstretch as #12 and #47 also crash on the backstretch.  The caution waves, with #60 in front of #7 and #60 is declared the winner and clinches the final Chase spot.  Cars involved in the accidents: #1, #3, #5, #10, #16, #21, #22, #34, #38, #45, #51, #54, #78, #97
